question: What is the primary physical property gluten gives to bread dough?
explanation: Gluten acts as a structural protein network that traps gas and gives dough its stretchy texture. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h1)

question: Which grain is completely safe for a patient following a strict gluten-free diet?
explanation: Rice is a naturally gluten-free grain, whereas barley, spelt, and rye all contain the gluten protein. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h1)

question: What intestinal structure is primarily damaged during a celiac disease immune response?
explanation: Gluten triggers inflammation that flattens the absorptive villi lining the small intestine in celiac disease. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h2)

question: How does non-celiac gluten sensitivity differ from celiac disease?

options.A: It is always permanent in every patient
options.B: It lacks specific antibodies and villous damage
options.D: It causes respiratory failure instead of bloating

explanation: Patients with gluten sensitivity experience symptoms without the characteristic tissue damage or antibodies found in celiac disease. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h2)

question: Which pseudocereal is naturally safe for a gluten-restricted diet?
explanation: Quinoa is a seed-based grain substitute that contains zero gluten and offers complete protein. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h3)

question: A patient asks if plain grilled chicken breast with steamed rice is safe. What is your response?

options.A: No, because rice must be chemically treated before eating
options.B: Yes, provided the chicken was marinated in dark soy sauce
options.C: Yes, because both items are naturally free of gluten
options.D: No, because poultry products always contain hidden wheat fillers

explanation: Unprocessed meats and plain rice do not contain wheat, barley, or rye. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h3)

question: Why is standard soy sauce problematic for someone avoiding gluten?

options.A: It is manufactured in facilities that process raw peanuts
options.B: It uses barley malt extract exclusively for sweetening
options.C: It is traditionally brewed using fermented wheat alongside soybeans
options.D: It contains high levels of dairy protein and lactose

explanation: Traditional soy sauce lists wheat as a primary ingredient, making standard varieties unsafe. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h4)

question: Which common alcoholic beverage must be avoided on a strict gluten-free diet?
explanation: Standard beer is brewed from barley or wheat malt, making it high in gluten content. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h4)

question: What is a common nutritional drawback of relying heavily on processed gluten-free foods?

options.A: Dangerous accumulation of vitamins in the liver
options.B: Severe protein toxicity from unabsorbed amino acids
options.C: Excessive water intake causing electrolyte dilution
options.D: Lower fiber and vitamin content compared to enriched wheat

explanation: Commercial substitutes are often made from refined flours that lack fortification and natural fiber. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h5)

question: Which micronutrient deficiency is most commonly monitored in celiac disease due to malabsorption?
explanation: Iron deficiency anemia is a frequent clinical finding because primary absorption occurs in the damaged duodenum and upper jejunum. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h5)

question: How does cross-contamination typically happen in a home kitchen?

options.A: Washing cooking utensils with standard dish soap and water
options.B: Using the same toaster for regular and gluten-free bread
options.C: Storing raw vegetables on the bottom shelf of a clean fridge
options.D: Boiling plain white rice in a freshly washed stainless steel pot

explanation: Toasters retain crumb residue that easily transfers gluten to alternative bread slices. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h6)

question: Which ingredient on a food label indicates the presence of a gluten-containing grain?
explanation: Malt is typically derived from barley, which contains gluten. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h6)

question: A newly diagnosed patient is preparing to return home. What is the most practical first step a nurse should recommend?

options.A: Stopping all vitamin supplements to prevent irritation
options.B: Switching immediately to a raw vegetarian diet
options.C: Ordering all future meals exclusively from online restaurants
options.D: Conducting a thorough pantry clean-out to remove hidden gluten

explanation: Removing unsafe foods from the home environment prevents accidental ingestion during the early adjustment phase. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h7)

question: Why is ongoing nutritional follow-up important for patients managing celiac disease?

options.A: To confirm intestinal healing and monitor nutrient levels
options.B: To calculate weekly body mass index changes
options.C: To ensure the patient has stopped eating fresh vegetables
options.D: To test for immunity against common viral infections

explanation: Follow-up care tracks mucosal recovery and ensures blood vitamin levels return to normal ranges. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T011#GNS227_U6_T011_h7)
